title: R' Yudan bar Chalfai

paragraphs: Yuchasin and Seder HaDorot cite this name from Vayikra Rabbah 10:3. But Hyman says the plain sense there is that R' Yudan said Bar Chalfai asked, with Bar to be corrected to Rabbi.[^1][^2]

notes.text: סה״ד is contextually Seder HaDorot, not Sefer HaDorot; ויק״ר/פ״י-ג give Vayikra Rabbah 10:3 without fresh edition verification.

שבר is parsed that-Bar, not son-of, showing Hyman’s resegmentation from alleged patronymic to Yudan reporting another person’s question. His parenthesis צ״ל רבי supplies the full title Rabbi explicitly for the proposed Chalfai reading and is preserved as such. It does not expand either Yudan occurrence. Source פשם is contextually understood as פשט/plain sense, without changing Hebrew or claiming printed certainty. בעי is asked; Hyman’s interpretation and correction are not admitted source history.
